author: SickProdigy
description: Query an AzerothCore SOAP endpoint for server info, online players, and account creation.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild configuration such as API endpoint settings and allowed role IDs. It does not persist user-provided account data.
install_msg: Configure the SOAP endpoint with `[p]azerothcore set soap_url <ip:port>`, then set SOAP credentials with `[p]azerothcore set soap_auth <user> <pass>` and account creation roles with `[p]azerothcore set accountcreationrole <role...>`. Roles can be mentions, IDs, or exact names. Use `[p]azerothcore set realmlist <text>` for the public WoW connection line, `[p]azerothcore set timeout <seconds>` for SOAP timeouts, and `[p]azerothcore set onlinecommand <command>` if your build uses a custom who-is-online command. Use `[p]azerothcore soapcheck` to test TCP reachability. Commands also work with `[p]wow` and `[p]ac`.
name: AzerothCore
short: Interact with an AzerothCore server through SOAP
